Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Hanging Cord
The hanging cord gives the ornament a defined attachment point for a suitable support. It allows the decorative face to remain visible and makes it easy to include the piece among other hanging accents in the intended display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Handmade Detail
Handmade detailing contributes to the character of the design. The decorative elements give the product a distinct appearance that can be coordinated with the surrounding arrangement.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Stated size: 8 x 7 cm. Quantity: 3 pack.
Handmade detailing adds character and distinct appearance to your festive display.
Compact 8 x 7 cm format fits easily into smaller spaces without clutter.
Includes a 3-pack quantity for coordinated styling across multiple areas.
Designed as a versatile finishing touch to refresh your Christmas arrangement.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Included: 3x Christmas decorations

Create a cheerful Christmas welcome with this Santa Stop Here Light Up Sign featuring 30 multicolour LEDs and eight lighting functions. Designed with festive red and white colours, snowy accents and a bold Santa Stop Here message, the decoration adds seasonal character to gardens, pathways, porches and entrance displays. The built-in timer provides six hours of lighting followed by eighteen hours off, automatically repeating the cycle each day once activated. Add rustic charm and festive cheer to your home this Christmas with the Three Kings Cone, a 45cm free-standing decoration that brings the outdoors in.

Built on a strong internal structure and shaped like a miniature Christmas tree, it's beautifully finished with natural pinecones, winter greenery and bright red berries to create a rich and seasonal display.

It's the perfect piece for smaller spaces where a full-size tree may not fit or for adding festive interest to mantelpieces, shelves or side tables.

There's no assembly required. It arrives ready to display straight out of the box, making it ideal for those who want quick, easy ways to decorate without compromising on quality or impact. It's also a thoughtful gift idea for anyone who loves seasonal decorating but doesn't want the hassle of fresh foliage.

Supplied as a 45cm decoration.
NATURAL FESTIVE STYLE: Add warmth and rustic character to your Christmas display with this 45cm tree decoration made from real pinecones, evergreen foliage and red berries.
READY TO DISPLAY: Arrives fully assembled and free-standing so you can instantly enhance your home with a festive centrepiece, with zero set-up or fuss.
REUSABLE & VERSATILE: Use it year after year as a charming addition to tabletops, hallway corners or guest rooms that need a seasonal sparkle.
DETAILS: Supplied as a decorative free-standing tree structure, 45cm tall. Simply unpack and place it wherever you’d like to create instant Christmas charm.
ABOUT US: At YouGarden, we believe that gardening is for everyone. Based in rural Lincolnshire we have our own 11 acre nursery, meaning that we are in close contact with our plants, so that we can guarantee our plants will thrive because we've grown them ourselves. We also source product locally, nationally and internationally to ensure we give our customers the best range, highest quality and greatest value for money. All our products will arrive in nursery fresh condition.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use

This inflatable snowman adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The white and red finish and polyester construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.
